_comment: Sample IBM Bob enterprise policy. Linux: /etc/bob/policy.json (root:root, 644); macOS: com.ibm.bob MDM profile; Windows: Software\Policies\IBM\Bob. Remove this _comment key before deploying. DisabledAutoApprovalGroups=mode makes every mode switch a visible human click (stricter teams use mode,edit,execute). EnforcedHooks is a JSON-encoded string; enforced hooks run before workspace hooks and users cannot remove them. In repositories without sdd/scripts/bob-hook.mjs the command fails, which Bob logs and ignores.
